annotations.title: Generate a Power Apps modern theme (YAML)

description: Builds the YAML for a Power Apps modern theme from a brand color, ready for Themes > Add a theme > Paste theme (modern controls, Fluent v9). Same logic and byte-identical output as the PowerPlatformTip 'Image to Power Apps Theme' tool. Use it when a user wants an app in their brand colors. Power Apps derives the 16-slot ramp from BasePaletteColor; HueTorsion and Vibrancy (-100 to 100) adjust it. The Paste theme format has no light/dark setting. Optional: Creator Kit (Fluent v8) palette as JSON and as a Power Fx Set() block.

baseColor.description: Brand color as hex, for example #2e4bf0 or 2E4BF0 or #26f

colorOverrides.description: Optional fixed colors per slot: Lighter30, Lighter20, Lighter10, Base, Darker10, Darker20, Darker30, Darker40

font.description: CSS font family (default 'Segoe UI', 'Open Sans', sans-serif)

includeCreatorKit.description: Also return the Creator Kit (Fluent v8) palette JSON and Power Fx block

name.description: Theme name shown in Studio (default MyBrandTheme)
